# Topics

## Topic names


## Headings

```````````````````````````````` example

# Plan #pricing

## Notes #

# Close #tag ##

│   └── Topic scope=1:1..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} name="hashtag" children=0
├── Heading scope=3:1..3:15 anchor="plan-pricing" attributes={} level=1 children=2
│   ├── Text scope=3:3..3:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Plan " children=0
│   └── Topic scope=3:8..3:15 anchor=null attributes={} name="pricing" children=0
├── Heading scope=5:1..5:10 anchor="notes" attributes={} level=2 children=1
│   └── Text scope=5:4..5:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Notes" children=0
└── Heading scope=7:1..7:15 anchor="close-tag" attributes={} level=1 children=2
    ├── Text scope=7:3..7:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Close " children=0
    └── Topic scope=7:9..7:12 anchor=null attributes={} name="tag" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Opaque contents

```````````````````````````````` example
`#code` <span id="#x">#in</span> <!-- #c --> $#f$ %% #p %%
.

└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:58 anchor=null attributes={} children=11
    ├── Code scope=1:1..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="#code" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:8..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    ├── HTML scope=1:9..1:22 anchor=null attributes={} literal="<span id=\"#x\">" children=0
    ├── Topic scope=1:23..1:25 anchor=null attributes={} name="in" children=0
    ├── HTML scope=1:26..1:32 anchor=null attributes={} literal="</span>" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:33..1:33 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    ├── Comment scope=1:34..1:44 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" #c " children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:45..1:45 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    ├── Formula scope=1:46..1:49 anchor=null attributes={} mode=embedded literal="#f" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:50..1:50 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    └── Comment scope=1:51..1:58 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" #p " children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Failed constructs

```````````````````````````````` example
{#unclosed :n{#x "bad}
.
Document scope=1:1..1:22 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:22 anchor=null attributes={} children=5
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:1 anchor=null attributes={} literal="{" children=0
    ├── Topic scope=1:2..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} name="unclosed" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:11..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" :n{" children=0
    ├── Topic scope=1:15..1:16 anchor=null attributes={} name="x" children=0
    └── Text scope=1:17..1:22 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" \"bad}" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example

.

└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=4
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[[A#" children=0
    ├── Topic scope=1:5..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} name="B" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:7..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="]] [" children=0
    └── Topic scope=1:11..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} name="x" children=0
````````````````````````````````
